entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Pankaj Pal And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Anand Prakash Dubey,Prashant Kumar Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

At the very outset, Sri Anand Prakash Dubey, learned counsel for the applicants seeks to withdraw the present application wherein the challenge has been raised in Case no.5470 of 2023 (State v.
Pankaj Pal and others), arising out of case crime no. 112 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504,
506 & 494 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act against the applicant no. 1 and under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act against the applicant nos. 2 and 3, police station Bhopa,
District Muzaffar Nagar, on account of incurable technical defects with liberty to file afresh.
2.

entities.text:
Case no.5470 of 2023 (State v.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned AGA has no objection to the same.
3. The application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty aforesaid.
